rationale: 17 days of the existing 26-object exam stay out of train, val and holdout.
Train is two blocks: early earthworks 2-28 Jan and structure 20 May-29 Jun, sampled every few days.
Val is one February episode, 11 days after the last January train frame and months before May train.
Holdout is October-November facade/street phase, months after the last train frame. 2026-10-01 stays control.
Adjacent days of one visit are not split across train and test.
Tower crane is one physical machine present for many months; that limitation is recorded, not hidden.
